scope: 50 synthetic dev jobs stratified by label kind and persona. All arms share deterministic analysis, writer and policy tools. The prebuilt single-agent ReAct and the installed LangGraph Supervisor reference use scripted tool calls. No model inference, tokens, clients contacted or proposals sent. Local timings and per-job failure annotations are in architecture.dev.json.
